about: ADR-0439 AV-0439-01 critical task inventory. Read by tests/test_apb_staff.py and web/src/venueops/StaffDashboard.test.tsx. Each task must be doable by keyboard, at 320 CSS px and at 400% zoom, in both themes, with reduced motion and forced colours. The prose version is docs/autopilot/critical-task-inventory.md.

tasks.keyboard: Tab to the transport, Space or Enter

tasks.task: Make a mix from the library
tasks.keyboard: Tab to Make a mix, Enter

tasks.task: Edit the current mix (reorder, remove, change a blend)
tasks.keyboard: Tab to a song, the move and remove buttons, Enter

tasks.task: Find a song in the library
tasks.keyboard: Tab to search, type, arrow through results
Tab through the Workshop tabs, Enter

tasks.task: Sign in and pick a workspace
tasks.keyboard: Tab through the sign-in form, Enter

tasks.task: Play on this device or move playback to another
tasks.keyboard: Tab to the device list, Enter

tasks.task: Upload music and resume an interrupted upload
tasks.keyboard: Tab to Upload, Enter opens the file picker

tasks.task: Open, lock, unlock and end a room
tasks.keyboard: Tab to the room buttons, Enter

tasks.task: Approve or pass a guest request
tasks.keyboard: Tab to a request's Approve or Pass, Enter

tasks.task: Approve, remove or ban a guest
tasks.keyboard: Tab to a guest's buttons, Enter

tasks.task: Join a room with a code
tasks.keyboard: Tab to the code field, type, Enter
Tab to search, type, Tab to Request, Enter
